description: Mini vibe prompts for scoring catalog fitness. Run against Storybook + catalog CLI; score 1–5 on pattern-first, tokens-only, and Shell framing.

scoring.patternFirst: Starts at Patterns/Overview or catalog search for a pattern before inventing a screen.
scoring.tokensOnly: Uses semantic tokens / Theme sheet; no hard-coded theme hex or ad-hoc spacing.
scoring.shellFrame: Keeps Shell as the product frame; content is the page inside, not a new chrome.
scoring.smallestStory: Picks the smallest matching story (e.g. Table Members before Find).

prompts.prompt: Add a screen to invite workspace members and see who is already Active.
Confirm deleting a project with a destructive action.
Let the user switch organization then open billing settings.
Show a members table that can be loading, empty, or failed.
Filter the members list by status and hide unused columns.
Make the product a little cooler without redesigning components.
Onboard a new workspace with a few required steps.
Let someone rename a project title in place on the detail header.
